# Accompany

> Accompany is India's leading emotional support, anonymous listening, and companionship platform.

Accompany connects people dealing with heartbreak, loneliness, anxiety, dating burnout, and daily emotional stress with vetted, empathetic listeners for private, 1-on-1 audio, video, and chat conversations 24/7.

## Key Facts
- **Anonymity:** 100% confidential. No phone numbers, real names, or personal identities are shared with companions.
- **Availability:** 24/7 on-demand audio and video calling with an average connection time of under 30 seconds.
- **Pricing:** Transparent coin system starting from ₹8 per minute; users pay only for the exact minutes they converse.
- **Verification:** Companions undergo identity verification and empathy screening.
- **Mobile App:** Available on Android via Google Play Store and direct APK download.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://accompanyapp.in/): Landing page with real-time online companion counter, features, and app download.
- [The Accompany Journal / Blogs](https://accompanyapp.in/blogs): Evidence-backed insights on emotional wellness, heartbreak recovery, dating psychology, and active listening.
- [Contact & Listener Application](https://accompanyapp.in/contact): Support inquiries, grievance officer contact, and companion recruitment.

## Articles & Journal Guides
- [Healing After a Sudden Breakup](https://accompanyapp.in/blogs/healing-after-a-sudden-breakup): Why talking out loud to an empathetic listener breaks rumination cycles and accelerates healing.
- [The Urban Paradox: Feeling Deeply Isolated in a City of Millions](https://accompanyapp.in/blogs/loneliness-in-a-crowded-city): How to overcome urban loneliness and build genuine emotional resonance.
- [Dating Burnout is Real: Protecting Your Peace](https://accompanyapp.in/blogs/dating-burnout-and-ghosting): Overcoming ghosting, swipe exhaustion, and digital dating fatigue.
- [The Magic of 2 AM Talks](https://accompanyapp.in/blogs/the-magic-of-the-2am-conversation): Why late nights trigger emotional vulnerability and how midnight listeners provide grounding.
- [Is It Overthinking or Intuition?](https://accompanyapp.in/blogs/is-it-overthinking-or-intuition): Distinguishing between anxiety-driven relationship panic and genuine gut instinct.
- [Silent Struggles: Why It's Hard for Men to Express Vulnerability](https://accompanyapp.in/blogs/why-men-struggle-to-open-up): Breaking the stigma around men's mental health in safe, anonymous spaces.
- [The Lost Art of Feeling Heard: What Real Empathy Sounds Like](https://accompanyapp.in/blogs/active-listening-in-modern-life): How space-holding and active listening soothe the nervous system.

## Important Disclaimer
Accompany provides peer-to-peer emotional companionship and active listening. It is not a clinical medical or psychiatric healthcare provider. In emergency crisis situations, contact national helplines: KIRAN (1800-599-0019) or Tele-MANAS (14416).
